market_outlook.short_term: Oil shock from Middle East war dominates near-term risk. Expect elevated volatility, bond yield spikes, and EM importer stress. Energy equities outperform. Dot-com-level valuations create fragility—any 5.5% Treasury yield breach triggers equity correction. Bitcoin ETF flows positive. Auto sector under tariff pressure. 1-3 month: choppy, risk-off bias with energy as primary driver.
market_outlook.long_term: AI/semiconductor capex cycle (ASML, Baidu) supports structural equity upside. Record IPO pipeline (Jio, Dangote, Musinsa) signals capital market confidence. EM rotation into tech-led markets (Poland, India) continues. EV transition moderating with hybrid resurgence. Retirement/wealth management shifts (529 plans, RMD strategies) create steady demand. 6-12 month: selective equity upside in AI/EM, but oil and valuation risks cap broad rallies.
